instructions: ill_cond_50 has condition number κ≈1000. dmhmc's default integration_steps_fn = Uniform(1,10) draws trajectory lengths too short to traverse the elongated posterior axes at this condition number. NUTS (nuts + window_adaptation_diag_imm) is the recommended sampler for this model.
workflow:
Phase 3c (2026-05-19): ill_cond_50 x window_adaptation_diag_imm x dmhmc FAILed with rhat=1.17-1.68, ess=6-17 across all 4 dynamic_hmc/dmhmc cells. The failure mode is identical to dynamic_hmc: random-L ∈ [1,10) from blackjax's default integration_steps_fn is far too short for κ≈1000.

dmhmc adds multinomial proposal sampling on top of dynamic_hmc's random-L mechanism; the multinomial proposal does not rescue the trajectory-length problem — it only changes the proposal distribution within the same trajectory, not the trajectory length.

Diagnosis: At κ≈1000 the long posterior axis requires roughly sqrt(κ)≈32 leapfrog steps. Random-L ∈ [1,10) covers at most 1/3 of an orbit. The warmup's diagonal IMM adaptation compresses κ but residual anisotropy still demands L >> 10.
